meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建或编辑自定义视频组合，用于多场景、品牌片、蒙太奇等
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要进行专业视频创作而无现成模板可用
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need professional video creation with no pre-built template

howto.what: 装好此技能后，Claude 能根据需求创建或编辑多场景视频项目，包括动画、媒体处理和项目状态管理，并遵循预设的工作流。
howto.when: 当你想制作较长或多场景视频（如品牌预告片、蒙太奇）但没有更专门的工作流时，或当 BRIEF.md 设为 'companion' 模式时，此技能会自动接管。

howto.what_en: Claude creates or edits multi-scene video projects, handling animation, media processing, and project state according to the workflow steps, when no specialized skill fits or when brief sets companion flow.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to create longer or multi-scene videos like brand reels or montages without a dedicated workflow, or when BRIEF.md sets flow to companion. Also used for editing existing projects.

say_en.text: Create a 30-second brand video with intro, product showcase, and outro scenes.
Continue from existing project state, add a voiceover and background music.
say_en.note: Applies media adapter and companion flow.
